description: This file defines the SyncSettingsFragment class, a user interface component for managing synchronization settings in an Android application. It includes methods for observing preferences, handling user interactions, and configuring synchronization options related to cloud services, storage locations, and credentials.

classes.name: SyncSettingsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment class providing user interface controls for synchronizing app data with various cloud services and storage options. It manages preferences, user interactions, and external dialogs related to synchronization settings.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, sets up observers, and configures UI interactions after the view has been created.

methods.name: setupPreferenceObservers
methods.description: Sets up observers to update UI components based on preference changes.

methods.name: setupLocalLocationListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener for the storage location setting to launch a location picker.

methods.name: setupNextcloudServerListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener to show the Nextcloud server configuration dialog.

methods.name: setupNextcloudAccountListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener to show the Nextcloud account selection dialog.

methods.name: setupSyncServiceListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener to show the cloud service selection dialog.

methods.name: setupSyncModeListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener to show the synchronization mode selection dialog.

methods.name: setupBackgroundSyncListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener to show the background synchronization preference dialog.

methods.name: setupNewNotesSyncableListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener to show the preference for new notes synchronization.

methods.name: setupTrustCertificatesListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener for trusting self-signed certificates.

methods.name: setupClearNextcloudCredentialsListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener to clear stored Nextcloud credentials.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Extension function to toggle visibility of UI components.

calls: API for observing LiveData / flows: collect
